title: Competitor watch: weekly digest & battlecards
summary: Emails you this week's competitor news, plus a battlecard for every upcoming meeting where a competitor comes up.
trigger: Manual run (list of competitors); schedule it weekly
setup: Import the template and connect Google Calendar and Gmail.
Run it with up to 5 competitors (names or websites, one per line or comma-separated).
The digest is emailed to your connected Gmail address. Set `recipients` to send it to a team list instead.
To get it every Monday, add a weekly schedule to the playbook and save your competitors as the default input.
Edit the `competitor-watch-analyst` agent to change the digest format or battlecard sections.
notes: Reports the last 7 days of news on every run. Templates can't keep state between runs yet, so it can't show only what changed since the last digest.
A meeting gets a battlecard when an attendee's email domain or the meeting title matches a competitor. Matching on names is simple and can miss meetings or flag the wrong ones.
Up to 5 competitors and 10 battlecards per run, to keep the run fast.
